clauses.text: 3% interest subvention (~18% NPV of capex) capped at Rs. 35 Lakhs.

clauses.title: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF) — Dairy & Feed MSME — Verification Checklist
clauses.text: Applicant enterprises applying for Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF) — Dairy & Feed MSME must furnish: udyam_certificate, gstin_certificate, fssai_license, project_report_dpr. Enterprise legal name and constitution must match across Udyam Registration and GSTIN certificates.
